title: Implantable Infusion Pumps for Intrathecal Therapy
description: CMS National Coverage Determination for implantable intrathecal drug delivery systems (NCD 160.18). Requires severe intractable chronic pain of malignant or non-malignant origin, failure of oral or transdermal opioids/adjuvants, and documented response to a preliminary trial injection.

criteria.name: Successful Intrathecal Preliminary Trial Response
criteria.description: Documented positive clinical response (>= 50% pain reduction or reduction in intolerable side effects) to a temporary preliminary trial injection of intrathecal medication.
criteria.clinical_intent: Verify trial responsiveness before permanent implantation
criteria.source_text_excerpt: The patient's history must indicate that he/she would not respond adequately to noninvasive methods of pain control, such as systemic opioids (including attempts to eliminate physical and behavioral abnormalities which may cause an exaggerated reaction to pain); and a preliminary trial of intraspinal opioid drug administration must be undertaken with a temporary intrathecal/epidural catheter to substantiate adequately acceptable pain relief and degree of side effects (including effects on the activities of daily living) and patient acceptance.

criteria.name: Intolerable Side Effects or Failure of Systemic Analgesics
criteria.description: Documented intractable pain unresponsive to systemic oral/transdermal analgesics, or failure due to severe dose-limiting adverse effects.
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm exhaustion of non-invasive systemic pharmacotherapy
criteria.source_text_excerpt: The patient's history must indicate that he/she would not respond adequately to noninvasive methods of pain control, such as systemic opioids (including attempts to eliminate physical and behavioral abnormalities which may cause an exaggerated reaction to pain); and a preliminary trial of intraspinal opioid drug administration must be undertaken with a temporary intrathecal/epidural catheter to substantiate adequately acceptable pain relief and degree of side effects (including effects on the activities of daily living) and patient acceptance.

criteria.name: Active Systemic Sepsis Exclusion
criteria.description: Active systemic infection, sepsis, meningitis, or localized infection at the proposed pump pocket site.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude active infection prior to foreign body implantation
